purpose: Determine whether the existing Kalshi API identity can access CF Benchmarks historical BRTI values, without requesting any experiment-period value.

facts: Everything after /trade-api/v2/cfbenchmarks/ is forwarded to https://www.cfbenchmarks.com/api/v1/.
The request uses ordinary Kalshi authentication and the signature path excludes the query string.
The passthrough requires an account entitlement.
Upstream authorization failure, server error, or timeout maps to HTTP 503; direct Kalshi authorization errors may be distinct.
One passthrough request costs 50 Read-bucket tokens.
Required parameters are id, timespan, and timestamp.
For a per-second RTI, allowed timespans are DAY or HOUR.
timespan syntax is the uppercase token HOUR, not an ISO duration.
timestamp is ISO8601 and must be truncated to the timespan boundary.
Historical access requires authorization for both the index and STREAM_HISTORICAL_VALUES.

recent_values_limit.fact: The values endpoint returns only the most recent hour for RTIs and cannot replace historical access.

single_probe.why_empty_and_non_experimental: The fixed hour predates BRTI and the project experiment dates by many years.

hard_guards: Reject a URL, query, or response-processing instruction containing any date from 2026-07-20 through 2026-07-23.
Do not call /cfbenchmarks/values because its recent-hour payload is not historical evidence.
Do not request, persist, print, hash, count, or summarize an experiment-period BRTI value.
Never print the API key ID, private-key path, signature, timestamp header, or environment values.
Do not retry; one request is sufficient and costs 50 Read-bucket tokens.
If a supposedly empty 200 response unexpectedly contains payload rows, record only row count and payload SHA-256, never row values.

next_step_gate.if_entitled: Stop after the availability receipt. Write and seal a separate calibration-download preregistration before requesting 2026-07-20..22.
next_step_gate.if_not_entitled_or_ambiguous: Do not request experiment-period history; report the exact HTTP code and sanitized error detail.
